tagline: AI tagging and chat for Paperless-ngx.
description: Automatically classifies Paperless-ngx documents with titles, tags, correspondents, and document types, and adds RAG-based natural-language search over the archive.

tips.before_install: Requires an existing Paperless-ngx instance. After installation, open the app and enter your Paperless URL, API token, and AI provider settings. Use `http://<casaos-ip>:8005/api` if Paperless runs in this store.

author: WisdomSky
